zh.hero_badge_spec: 持續深耕全端架構與即時系統工程
zh.hero_subtitle_pc: 全端開發／互動應用開發／多媒體設計
zh.hero_desc: 專注於全端軟體架構與即時互動系統開發。擅長串接底層資料邏輯與頂層沉浸式互動，堅持模組化設計與程式碼可維護性，致力於打造高穩定性且流暢的現代數位產品。
zh.about_intro: 具備新媒體藝術碩士背景，專注於全端網頁開發與互動應用架構設計。
zh.about_p1: 許哲誠，國立臺灣藝術大學新媒體藝術碩士。專精於全端系統架構、即時互動應用開發與現代多媒體視覺工程。具備獨立系統設計能力、前後端垂直整合與高效跨領域協作實務，擅長自主技術調研與工程落地，專注於建構兼具嚴謹資料邏輯與流暢互動體驗的現代數位系統。
zh.stat_projects_label: 涵蓋多種專案類型的開發經驗
zh.skills_intro: 整合 Java/Spring Boot 後端、Angular/React 前端、Unity/Unreal 即時渲染引擎與 3D 視覺管線之實務技術棧。
zh.skills_subtitle: 整合 Java/Spring Boot 後端、Angular/React 前端、Unity/Unreal 即時渲染引擎與 3D 視覺管線之實務技術棧。
zh.projects_note: 所有專案均包含真實展示畫面與相關連結，可點擊查看影片展示、線上網站或 GitHub 專頁。
zh.gallery_note: 展示個人 3D 場景建模、3D 精細物件、2D 麥克筆設計與素描作品，點擊圖片即可放大預覽。
zh.exp_intro: 包含新媒體藝術研究所歷程、國科會產學專案開發、次世代遊戲美術實務與全端整合工程訓練。
zh.edu_master: 國立臺灣藝術大學 — 新媒體藝術碩士班 (碩士)
zh.edu_master_desc: 主修新媒體藝術、VR/AR 互動應用架構與遊戲開發。畢業論文《覺醒協議：基於認知發展理論的虛擬實境遊戲設計》，獲臺藝大設計學院 114 學年度畢業創作影片補助。
zh.edu_bachelor: 國立虎尾科技大學 — 多媒體設計系 (大學)
zh.edu_bachelor_desc: 主修互動應用開發、3D 建模與互動視覺系統。榮獲 2022 全國專題競賽成果展示第一名、2021 臺灣數位媒體設計展銀賞及 2022 UE5 臺灣遊戲大賽佳作。
zh.thesis_1_title: 《覺醒協議》：基於認知發展理論的虛擬實境遊戲設計
zh.thesis_1_venue: 國立臺灣藝術大學設計學院 碩士論文
zh.thesis_1_desc: 採實踐本位研究，以 Piaget 認知發展四階段為設計架構，將感知探索至抽象推理轉譯為 VR 遞進關卡。獲設計學院畢業創作影片補助。
zh.thesis_2_title: 跑酷遊戲的創新策略：行動遊戲市場的案例研究
zh.thesis_2_venue: 2025 臺北數位圖像國際學術研討會
zh.thesis_2_desc: 運用文獻分析與案例研究，深入探討行動跑酷遊戲之多層次關卡、隨機生成與角色成長機制，提出遊戲市場創新與盈利改進建議。
zh.awards_intro: 取得多項國家級技術士證照、3D 數位設計認證與多益英語能力檢定。

en.hero_badge_spec: Continuous Research in Full-Stack Architecture & Real-Time Systems
en.hero_subtitle_pc: Fullstack Dev / Interactive App Dev / Multimedia Design
en.hero_desc: Dedicated to full-stack software architecture and real-time interactive systems. Skilled in bridging low-level data logic with high-fidelity immersive interaction, adhering to modular design and code maintainability, and committed to building stable, responsive digital products.
en.about_intro: Holding an M.A. in New Media Art, specializing in fullstack web engineering and interactive application architecture.
en.about_p1: Che-Cheng Hsu holds an M.A. in New Media Art from National Taiwan University of Arts. Specializing in full-stack system architecture, real-time interactive application development, and modern multimedia visual engineering. Possesses strong independent system design capability, vertical full-stack integration skills, and efficient cross-functional collaboration experience. Excels in autonomous technical research and engineering delivery, dedicated to building modern digital systems that seamlessly combine rigorous data logic with fluid interactive experiences.
en.stat_projects_label: Extensive Experience Across Multiple Project Domains
en.skills_intro: A solid technical stack integrating Java/Spring Boot backend, Angular/React frontend, Unity/Unreal real-time engines, and 3D visual pipelines.
en.skills_subtitle: A solid technical stack integrating Java/Spring Boot backend, Angular/React frontend, Unity/Unreal real-time engines, and 3D visual pipelines.
en.projects_note: All projects feature authentic previews and interactive links to explore video demos, live sites, or GitHub repositories.
en.gallery_note: Showcasing personal 3D environments, 3D props, 2D marker designs, and detailed sketches.
en.exp_intro: Spanning graduate research at NTUA, NSTC research projects, AAA game 3D asset production, and full-stack engineering bootcamps.
en.edu_master: National Taiwan University of Arts — M.A. in New Media Art (Master)
en.edu_master_desc: Majored in New Media Art, VR/AR interactive architecture, and app dev. Thesis: 'Awakening Protocol: VR Game Design Based on Cognitive Development Theory'. Awarded NTUA Graduation Film Grant.
en.edu_bachelor: National Formosa University — B.A. in Multimedia Design
en.edu_bachelor_desc: Majored in interactive application development, 3D modeling, and interactive systems. Won 1st Place in National Special Topic Competition and Silver Award in Taiwan Digital Media Design.
en.thesis_1_title: Awakening Protocol: Virtual Reality Game Design Based on Cognitive Development Theory
en.thesis_1_desc: Practice-based research translating Piaget's cognitive development stages into progressive VR gameplay. Awarded NTUA Graduation Film Grant.
en.thesis_2_title: Innovative Strategies of Parkour Games: A Case Study in Mobile Gaming Market
en.thesis_2_desc: Explores level design, procedural generation, and monetization in mobile runner games, proposing innovative frameworks for modern game design.
en.awards_intro: National technician licenses, 3D digital design certifications, and TOEIC English proficiency credentials.
